byDomain.limitation: **A corpus/config artifact, not an analyzer gap.** Each fixture configures exactly one rule, so every other advisory OSV returns produces one of these. It is not evidence the frontend could not understand the code — the frontend was never asked.

byDomain.limitation: Splits across two remediation owners (export attribution and target intelligence) that this dimension does not separate.
